column2: We broke every single barrier... so why can't we do any damage?!
Tch, looks like he caught on that his info leaked...
What do we do, Ban-chan? At this rate...
Don't make that face! We're the invincible GetBackers!!
No way in hell we're losing in a place like this!!
Everyone... can you hear my voice? I'm MAI. Mai Sakamoto.
A kind person arranged for me to be able to speak to all of you.
...I'm going to sing a song now.
I'm sure the streets of Shinjuku are in terrible trouble right now...
Even so, please don't lose hope.
Because somewhere in this city, there are people fighting...
Those people aren't fighting for our sake, but...
even so, they're fighting to take back the city of Shinjuku.
I'll sing this song for them.
...Oh, this melody... could it be...
The song of our homeland......?!
......Now's my chance!
Al... Must you defy me at every turn?!
Ban-chan, the barrier's gone!
All right, let's finish this!!
...Not yet! I cannot lose here...
Jend-sama, please stop this already!!
Silence, traitor! If only... if only you had never been...!!
A-Aaaaaaal!!
...Jend-sama, it is because of you that our clan will perish.
What are you saying?! Our clan shall not perish!!
We shall make this our new home and usher in an age of greater prosperity!!
Look... At your feet lie the corpses of so many, piled high...
Well, some things in this world are more fun because they stay a mystery.
Yeah!
And I kinda feel like Al-kun gave us lots of stuff money can't buy...
Well, let's leave it at that.
Then let's do our usual thing!
Ban / Ginji
...Thanks for your business!!
No, Jend-sama... We are not suffering at all.
Because... Jend-sama, you are our nation.
As long as you live on, our nation has not fallen...
Al... You are alive...
Ban
...Enjoy the dream?
A dream...? I see, a dream... I feel I have been in a bad dream all this time.
A long, painful dream...
I'm glad you woke up.
Indeed... It seems I awoke before things were beyond repair.
...Retrieval successful, right?
You bet! Man, that was one hell of a job...
But it all worked out, right, Al-kun!
...Al-kun?
!! Al-kun, hang in there! Al-kun!!
No... Take a good look, Ginji.
...ZZZ...ZZZ...ZZZ...
H-He's asleep... Phew, you scared me...
Looks like he's been on edge this whole time...
Let's let him get some rest.
Yeah, let's go home! Back to everyone!
Excuse me, you two there.
Huh? Photographer-san!
Me, all this time, I take photos of you. For spying.
But now no need, so I give you photos.
These photos, you save data after clear, and you start from that data,
then you can look at them in items.
But if you save data, you cannot play ACT 8, so be careful, yes?
I hope photos come out good, yes!
Th-Thanks...
Got the TSC Data!
Al-kun, are you feeling all better now?
Yes, all healthy now! Thanks to everyone.
Good to hear.
But come to think of it, you were behind most of this whole mess, weren't you?
You look like an idiot, but you're a real schemer.
What are you saying? Al is the greatest strategist of our clan.
Ban / Ginji
...Even though he's this spaced out?
He seems so because he is running all manner of calculations in his head.
...Then how come he couldn't count money?
His sense of money is off because he has no greed for it whatsoever.
Ban / Ginji
(Ban-chan... You really can't judge people by their looks...)
(...Man, it's a scary world out there.)
By the way, Al, here's a going-away present from us.
Ah... An orb......
Thank you very much. Ban-san, scary face, but good person.
...You're still on that?
Gin-san too, thank you for helping.
Everyone is good people... I will not forget all of you.
It's gonna be lonely without you, Al-kun...
Write me a letter sometimes, okay? I'll write back.
Take care, Jend-san.
I have committed an unforgivable sin...
To flee without atoning for it...
If you're feeling guilty, then make it up to the people of your clan.
And to do that, you can't let yourself get caught in a place like this...
Am I wrong?
Indeed... You are right.
Well, if anything comes up, give us a call.
We'll come running to the ends of the earth. We're the invincible GetBackers!
...Then farewell. I am in your debt.
Goodbye! Ban-san, Gin-san!!
...They're gone.
Yeah...
Oh, isn't that the DVD-ROM with the thesis on it?
...What are you gonna do with it?
There's supposed to be treasure sleeping in there...
Must be tons of amazing treasure...
...Let's toss it!
Yeah, sounds good! I think that's best.
Ban Mido, we of the Miroku clan will defeat you without fail.
Be sure to survive... until the day we meet again.
...Huh, is my cell ringing?
It's been a while, Ginji-san.
What's up, MakubeX?
I've got some inside info involving Alpha Tower.
Huh... Is it something bad?
Yes...
There's a bomb planted in that building.
...A bomb?!
Wh-What do you mean?!
They mean to wipe out the building's occupiers in one blow with a bomb.
It seems someone in the government has opted for drastic measures...
It's a time-fused RDX bomb.
RDX???
It's a high-powered explosive.
If it's planted in the support pillars, it could take out a building like this, right?
It could... easily.
No... That's just wrong!!
We have to stop it! Right, Ban-chan?!
Damn straight! No way I'm letting anybody mess with our job!!
...I knew you two would say that.
The bomb seems to be planted somewhere on the upper floors,
but there should still be some time before it's set to go off.
Please find it, no matter what.
Okay! Thanks, MakubeX.
I'll call you again once we find it.
Okay, let's take the elevator and hurry upstairs!!
What do we do? We have to hurry and keep going...
In that case, why not leave this to me?
Huh? But...
You're in a hurry, right?
Thanks, Kagami-san!!
More enemies...
Well, leave this one to the great Ban Mido.
Ban-chan...
In exchange, you'd better stop that bomb. Hurry, Ginji!!
Okay! Be careful too, Ban-chan!!
...Again, more enemies...
Then shall I go?
A-Akabane-san...
I was getting rather bored myself... Something like this is not so bad.
Please, Akabane-san!!
I suppose it's my turn now?
No way! I can't leave you behind, Himiko-chan.
Don't be so soft. I can handle a guy like this all by myself.
...Sorry, Himiko-chan!!
Oh! Before ya knew it, it's turned into the old VOLTS crew, huh?
Huh? Oh... Yeah, it has.
Then I gotta go! No need for the Thunder Emperor or the Four Kings to show up!!
...I'm counting on you, Emishi!!
There's still more...
Thunder Emperor, leave this to me.
What is it? Do you not trust my strength?
I'm counting on you, Juubei!
Before we knew it, it's just us left.
...Shido.
VOLTS, huh...
Well, that's ancient history.
Whatever the case, you've gotta keep moving forward.
Go.
Okay... Sorry, Shido!
Ginji-san, here...
You're not gonna say you'll fight alone, are you?
Let's fight together, Kazu-chan!
No, you mustn't. There should be something you have to do.
Leave this to me, and go on ahead.
It's all right, Ginji-san. You can do things that I cannot...
And that is probably something only you can do.
Please go, Ginji-san.
...Be careful, Kazu-chan.
Looks like I caught up?
Huh, Kagami-san!
What about everyone else?!
Who knows... I didn't run into anyone.
Then again, it felt like I got pulled into another dimension during the fight...
so I doubt you could meet them even if you tried.
What're you dawdling for? I went and caught up with you!
B-Ban-chan! I'm so glad you're okay~!!
Overdramatic as ever, you dope...
All right, let's get fired up and go!
Yeah!!
Found it, Ban-chan!!
Ginji... Don't you go touching that bomb with your hands all charged up.
Last thing we need is you setting off the detonator.
...Looks like only one of them is on a timer?
So they're gonna set off the rest in a chain...
Oh, then if we cut this wire, the others won't blow up, right?
Cut the wire and it'll blow the second you do.
Guess leaving it to this guy was a mistake from the start...
I-It's okay, we've got MakubeX...
No good... I can't get a signal......
What do we do...
Cooling it is the only way to buy time, I'd say.
Liquid nitrogen, huh... Is there even any in this building?
Dismantling it as is would be dangerous, so I think that's the only way, no?
Looks like we've got no choice but to look for it...
